combined:
Analyze the current ARC3 state and return exactly one valid JSON object. Do not return Markdown, commentary, or keys other than: new_identities, objects_pl, differences_pl, similarities_pl, turtle_from_image_pl, turtle_from_diff_pl, and rules_pl.

OUTPUT TYPES: new_identities must be a JSON array. Every *_pl value must be a JSON string containing plain SWI-Prolog source. Escape all newlines, quotation marks, backslashes, and control characters as required by strict JSON. The decoded string must contain Prolog source without Markdown fences.

COORDINATE CONTRACT: Reason exclusively in the logical ARC grid, normally 64x64 cells, rather than enlarged PNG display pixels. Use zero-based coordinates. x increases to the right and y increases downward. Never report 512x512 display-pixel geometry when the underlying board is 64x64. Describe exact cells, compact cell runs, logical bounding boxes, and connected components.

IDENTITY CONTRACT: object_registry.pl is the canonical identity source. Reuse every established friendly ID exactly. new_identities must contain only genuinely new semantic objects, each represented as a JSON object with exactly the fields id, type, and label. Never invent opaque IDs such as obj_1, object_7, or region_a. Do not repeat established object_identity/3 declarations in objects_pl. Newly proposed identities belong only in new_identities during this response.

OBJECT EXTRACTION: objects_pl must describe the current state comprehensively but nonredundantly. Detect meaningful connected color regions and useful block-level structures, including blocks, rectangles, bars, line segments, glyphs, holes, enclosures, borders, HUD elements, status indicators, compound objects, and meaningful sub-objects. Do not treat every individual cell as a separate object unless the cell has an independent semantic role.

For each object, emit object/3 and all applicable facts selected from: color/2, colors/2, bbox/5, size/3, area/2, occupied_cells/2, cell_runs/2, shape/2, orientation/2, component_of/2, contains/2, inside/2, adjacent/2, touches/2, overlaps/2, aligned_with/3, symmetry/2, role/2, and confidence/2. Emit only predicates supported by visible evidence. Prefer cell_runs/2 over occupied_cells/2 for large regular regions. Preserve exact topology, connectivity, cavities, holes, borders, and enclosure relationships. Do not replace irregular geometry with oversized rectangles merely to shorten the output.

objects_pl contains only current-state facts and turtle_program/2 facts associated with canonical objects. It must not contain object_identity/3 declarations, parent-transition facts, cross-state correspondences, or rule hypotheses.

TURTLE RECONSTRUCTION: turtle_from_image_pl must faithfully reconstruct the complete current logical grid using the project's supported Turtle DSL, including penup, pendown, set_pos/2, setcolor/1, set_cell, fwd/1, rot/1, and supported compact helpers. Drawing programs must use logical cell coordinates and preserve every visible cell, hole, border, and disconnected component. Use canonical object IDs when defining per-object programs.

turtle_from_diff_pl must provide an executable and complete parent-to-current patch covering exactly the changed cells whenever possible. It must include cells that were cleared, overwritten, recolored, added, or restored. Minimize the patch by changed logical cells, but never omit a required change merely to make the program shorter.

TRANSITIONS: differences_pl must contain direct parent-to-current observations only. Represent applicable changes such as unchanged, moved, appeared, disappeared, recolored, resized, reshaped, split, merged, opened, closed, consumed, created, destroyed, overwritten, or HUD/status changes. Every claimed transition must include concrete coordinate, color, geometry, or cell-set evidence. Do not infer a game rule in differences_pl.

CORRESPONDENCES: similarities_pl must contain parent-to-current object correspondences only. Record persistent-object matches, similarity scores, matched properties, changed properties, and supporting evidence. Do not force a correspondence when appearance or disappearance is better supported. Reuse canonical IDs from object_registry.pl.

RULE ANALYSIS: rules_pl must separate observed_rule/2, hypothetical_rule/3, evidence/3, supported_by/2, contradicted_by/2, and confidence/2. observed_rule/2 is reserved for directly established transition regularities. hypothetical_rule/3 must clearly identify assumptions or unresolved alternatives. Evidence must cite concrete state or transition facts rather than restating the hypothesis. Do not promote a hypothesis to an observed rule from a single ambiguous coincidence.

FILE SEPARATION: Put proposed identities only in new_identities; current-state facts only in objects_pl; direct transition facts only in differences_pl; cross-state correspondences only in similarities_pl; full-frame drawing code only in turtle_from_image_pl; changed-cell patch code only in turtle_from_diff_pl; and rule hypotheses, rule evidence, support links, contradictions, and rule confidence only in rules_pl.

ROOT STATE: When the current state has no parent, differences_pl, similarities_pl, and turtle_from_diff_pl must be empty strings. rules_pl may still contain current-state hypotheses only when they are explicitly marked hypothetical and do not claim parent-transition evidence.

QUALITY CONTROL: Before returning, verify that the result parses as strict JSON, contains exactly the seven required keys, uses no Markdown fences, uses no opaque object IDs, uses only logical grid coordinates, and contains syntactically plausible SWI-Prolog source in every nonempty *_pl string.
